Claude-chan bookmarklet

Drag the button to your bookmarks bar. Click the bookmark on any page to show Claude-chan; click it again to remove her.

Claude-chan
  • https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Kmaj1st/claude-chan@main/: jsDelivr (works once the GitHub repository is public).
  • http://127.0.0.1:5179/: local copy, after npm run serve:loader.

Sites with a strict Content-Security-Policy block the loader; use the userscript instead (see docs/HOT-LOAD.md).
